findings.claim: The observed landmark_00_soft_mass curve over score nodes 0.00-0.49 (14 independent batches) rises from about -0.37 z early to a mid-window peak near +1.6 z, then declines to about -0.28 z at the last node; the rate is positive early (first_rate_z ~ +9.3) and negative late (last_rate_z ~ -10.0), with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict. The whole-window level is weak (whole_window_z ~ 0.64) and no polynomial is accepted (relative_node_RMSE ~ 0.29). This is a changing contrast, not a stationary target.

The observed landmark_00_local_dy curve over score nodes 0.00-0.49 (14 independent batches) starts near +0.09 z, drops to about -1.26 z early, then recovers to about +0.13 z at the last node; the rate is strongly negative early (first_rate_z ~ -72.4) and positive late (last_rate_z ~ +5.5), with 6 sign changes and 4 strong sign conflicts. The whole-window level is weak (whole_window_z ~ -0.30) and no polynomial is accepted (relative_node_RMSE ~ 0.67).

The observed landmark_00_local_cxy curve over score nodes 0.00-0.49 (14 independent batches) rises to about +0.74 z early, falls to about -0.45 z mid-window, and ends near +0.11 z; the rate is strongly positive early (first_rate_z ~ +64.8) and negative late (last_rate_z ~ -19.7), with 9 sign changes and 14 strong sign conflicts. The whole-window level is weak (whole_window_z ~ +0.10) and no polynomial is accepted (relative_node_RMSE ~ 0.87).

The observed landmark_00_local_cyy curve over score nodes 0.00-0.49 (14 independent batches) starts near +0.13 z, falls to about -1.34 z mid-window, then recovers to about +0.25 z at the last node; the rate is negative early (first_rate_z ~ -36.5) and positive late (last_rate_z ~ +17.1), with 4 sign changes and 1 strong sign conflict. The whole-window level is weak (whole_window_z ~ -0.58) and no polynomial is accepted (relative_node_RMSE ~ 0.41).

landmark_00_local_dx shows a strong early negative rate (first_rate_z ~ -17.5) reversing to a positive late rate (last_rate_z ~ +8.1), with 6 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts; whole-window level is weak (whole_window_z ~ -0.18) and no polynomial is accepted.

landmark_00_local_czz shows an early positive rate (first_rate_z ~ +15.2) reversing to a negative late rate (last_rate_z ~ -6.3), with 7 sign changes and 6 strong sign conflicts; whole-window level is weak (whole_window_z ~ -0.31) and no polynomial is accepted.

landmark_00_local_dz shows an early positive rate (first_rate_z ~ +14.1) reversing to a negative late rate (last_rate_z ~ -2.4), with 10 sign changes and 7 strong sign conflicts; whole-window level is near zero (whole_window_z ~ -0.02) and no polynomial is accepted.

landmark_00_local_cxx shows an early negative rate (first_rate_z ~ -7.9) reversing to a positive late rate (last_rate_z ~ +15.9), with 6 sign changes and 2 strong sign conflicts; whole-window level is weak (whole_window_z ~ -0.58) and no polynomial is accepted.

landmark_00_local_cxz shows a positive early rate (first_rate_z ~ +8.8) and a positive late rate (last_rate_z ~ +10.0), with 7 sign changes and 2 strong sign conflicts; whole-window level is weak (whole_window_z ~ +0.14) and no polynomial is accepted.

landmark_00_local_cyz shows an early negative rate (first_rate_z ~ -16.4) reversing to a positive late rate (last_rate_z ~ +8.9), with 7 sign changes and 9 strong sign conflicts; whole-window level is weak (whole_window_z ~ -0.25) and no polynomial is accepted.

hypotheses.direction: time-dependent contrast; early positive rate, late negative rate; no single stationary direction supported
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-read of the same curve over the same support showing no sign reversal in the rate, or an accepted polynomial with stable sign, would falsify this contrast claim.
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score-node window [0.00, 0.49]
hypotheses.statement: For landmark_00_soft_mass, the observed curve over score nodes 0.00-0.49 rises to a mid-window peak and then declines, so the rate contrast is positive early and negative late while the whole-window level is weak; a coordinate reward that treats this feature as a stationary target over the full window would be mis-specified.

hypotheses.direction: time-dependent contrast; strong early negative rate, positive late rate
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-read of the same curve over the same support showing no sign reversal in the rate, or an accepted polynomial with stable sign, would falsify this contrast claim.
hypotheses.scope: global over the observed score-node window [0.00, 0.49]
hypotheses.statement: For landmark_00_local_dy, the observed curve over score nodes 0.00-0.49 drops early and recovers late, so the rate contrast is strongly negative early and positive late while the whole-window level is weak; the contrast is in the rate, not in a stationary offset.

hypotheses.direction: time-dependent contrast; strong early positive rate, negative late rate
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-read of the same curve over the same support showing no sign reversal in the rate, or an accepted polynomial with stable sign, would falsify this contrast claim.

hypotheses.statement: For landmark_00_local_cxy, the observed curve over score nodes 0.00-0.49 rises early, falls mid-window and partially recovers, so the rate contrast is strongly positive early and negative late with many strong sign conflicts; the whole-window level is weak.

hypotheses.direction: time-dependent contrast; early negative rate, positive late rate
hypotheses.falsifier: A re-read of the same curve over the same support showing no sign reversal in the rate, or an accepted polynomial with stable sign, would falsify this contrast claim.

hypotheses.statement: For landmark_00_local_cyy, the observed curve over score nodes 0.00-0.49 falls early and recovers late, so the rate contrast is negative early and positive late while the whole-window level is weak.

limitations: Stage profiles and temporal profiles are not available; only continuous curves and trend rows were read.
No decoded final affinity labels are present in the supplied evidence; selection preference is association, not descendant survival or measured final benefit.
No polynomial was accepted for any landmark_00 feature read (relative_node_RMSE high, extrapolation_allowed=false), so no extrapolation beyond the observed window is supported.
The rate contrasts above do not by themselves specify an absolute coordinate target or spatial gradient; no such target is asserted.
Only landmark_00 features were read; other landmarks were not queried and remain unobserved rather than absent.
